prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram
Asset type: one-page architecture diagram for a technical README, 3:2 landscape.
Primary request: Carefully edit the supplied "AI Agent Development Harness" diagram. Preserve the established composition, colors, icons, spacing system, and architecture. Correct the external research section and prioritize flawless Japanese typography over adding detail.

Exact title:
AI Agent Development Harness

Exact subtitle:
Codex main agent を中心に、人間の介入・skills・research・review・実行境界で実務開発ループを制御する構成

Layout and exact content:
- Top blue node: 人間
  Subtitle: 文脈・方針・停止判断
  Bullets: 目的・制約 / 事業文脈 / 仕様判断 / やらないこと
- Center green node: Codex main agent
  Subtitle: 実務担当のmain engineer
  Bullets: repo読解 / 実装 / 差分確認 / テスト確認 / 最終判断
- Left purple column: Context / Workflow
  1) OpenSpec / SDD — proposal / design / tasks / spec delta
  2) codex-loop-router — 最小workflowを選択
  3) Skills — context engineering / debugging loop / code review / interface review / doubt review / writing
- Right orange column: Review / Research / Advisor
  1) Subagents — bounded repo scout / 影響範囲調査 / evidence pack
  2) External research tools / scouts — Codex Web Search / Grok X Search / latest evidence / citations / 一次確認はmain agent
  3) Quality review loop — code / interface / doubt review
  4) Strategic advisors — Claude / Fable / Sol review / 採否はmain agent
- Bottom gray band: Execution harness
  Four boxes only: wrapper / rules / hooks / approval boundary
  Do not add any tiny explanatory sentence beneath these boxes.
- Protected red boxes: Git / AWS/GCP / GitHub CLI / Secrets / Production
- Teal Outputs node: 実装差分 / テスト結果 / PR body / design doc / 残リスク

Exact callouts:
1) 完全自動化ではない: 人間が文脈と停止判断を入れる
2) main agentに判断を集約: subagent・research scout・advisorは補助
3) skillsは手順書: 必要な時だけ読む
4) 危険操作は外側で止める: Git / cloud / secret / production

Arrows and labels:
- 人間 to Codex: 文脈・制約・判断を入力
- Codex back to 人間: ANDON / 判断が必要な時に戻す
- Bidirectional arrows between Codex and both side columns
- Codex to Execution harness: 外部操作は必ず経由
- Execution harness to protected resources: 危険操作を制御
- Outputs back to 人間: 確認・介入

Typography is the highest-priority invariant:
- Render every Japanese character as a crisp, standard Japanese sans-serif glyph comparable to Noto Sans JP or Hiragino Sans.
- The exact word "制御" appears in the subtitle and the lower label. Render both instances clearly and identically: 制御. Never approximate, deform, merge, substitute, or stylize these glyphs.
- Also preserve exact legibility for 文脈, 方針, 停止判断, 仕様判断, 影響範囲調査, 一次確認, 採否, 実装差分, 残リスク.
- Do not horizontally squeeze Japanese text. If text is tight, enlarge the box, wrap at phrase boundaries, reduce surrounding whitespace, or slightly reduce English text instead.
- Use no text smaller than the existing readable body text. Avoid condensed fonts and fake Japanese glyphs.
- Keep generous line height and prevent characters from touching borders, icons, bullets, or arrows.

Visual constraints:
- Preserve the supplied clean modern SaaS architecture-diagram style: white background, subtle dot grid, rounded rectangles, simple line icons, blue/purple/green/orange/gray/red/teal palette.
- Keep the central Codex node visually dominant.
- Do not create a linear backlog-to-merge pipeline.
- Do not make Grok, Web Search, subagents, research scouts, Claude, Fable, or Sol look like implementation owners.
- Do not connect research results directly to Git, cloud, Secrets, Production, or repo changes.
- Preserve all unchanged labels exactly and introduce no additional prose.
